summary: Modding improvements and bug fixes. Key breaking change: ZomboidFileSystem.validatePrefix now rejects FBX models stored under common/media/models_X/ — affects damnlib, KI5 vehicle mods, TacHold, KATTAJ1 Clothes Core, and others.

changes.description: Mod stores FBX models in common/media/models_X/ — rejected by B42.18 ZomboidFileSystem.validatePrefix. Models fail to load at runtime with 'Invalid prefix found for' errors.
changes.context: B42.18 tightened ZomboidFileSystem.validatePrefix path validation. FBX files under common/media/models_X/ are no longer accepted. Models must be moved to 42/media/models_X/ and all vehicle/model script references updated to match. Empirically observed affecting: damnlib, AutotsarMotorClub, TacHold, KATTAJ1 Clothes Core, KI5trailers, Buttstroke, AliceMod, ClimbDownRope.

changes.description: Server sandbox option DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected renamed to DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected in B42.18.
changes.context: B42.18 renamed this server option. Mods reading or comparing this sandbox setting by name will silently get nil/default instead of the server's configured value.

changes.description: B42.18 FluidContainerScript now sanitizes container names containing whitespace — names like 'Large Bucket' are auto-renamed, which may break mods referencing them by exact string.
changes.context: B42.18 added validation that rejects fluid container script names containing spaces. Mods that define fluid containers with multi-word names, or look them up by a name string containing spaces, may get unexpected results.
